Legend

The magistrates of Rathleton would gladly promote you within their ranks if you can fulfil their requirements.

Location

Rathleton

Dangers

None.

Reward

Ability to vote on several topics, ability to use various teleport within Oramond, and the ability to sail to and from Oramond from more cities, achievements Rathleton Commoner, Rathleton Inhabitant, Rathleton Citizen, Rathleton Squire.

Click to show/hide the quest spoiler.
(settings)
Spoiler • edit


Method

Do tasks in the Oramond Quest to obtain voting points. To spend them, go visit Marvin in the Rathleton Magistrate and talk to him about voting and then topic.

The cast votes are tallied on every other Monday, starting with the first Monday after Tibiadrome resets, during the Server Save and displayed on The Voting Results board.

No Rank

At this point, you will only be able to vote for the location of a shortcut leading back into the city of Rathleton: do you want it to be located in the Minotaur Hills (minotaurs), in the Lower Drainage Area (fungi), or in the Abandoned Sewers (catacombs)? You decide. The shortcut with the most votes will be established and can then be used. Every 14 days, the votes will be reset and the option which was the most popular at that time will take over.

After casting 50 successful votes, you will be able to ask for a promotion.

Commoner Rank

After your promotion to Commoner you will earn the achievement Rathleton Commoner and you will gain voting rights on one more topic: the so-called wish list. Do you want the nearby dungeon to be filled with Worker Golems and War Golems (golems), Oramond Minotaurs (minotaurs) or a combination of Destroyers, Hellspawns, Dark Torturers, Grim Reapers, Demons, and Juggernauts (the wrath of evil)? You decide. The creatures with the most votes will fill the dungeon. Every 14 days, the votes will be reset and the option which was the most popular at that time will take over.

You will also be able to sell Oramond-specific Creature Products to Alaistar.

After casting another 100 successful votes (150 in total), you will be able to ask for another promotion.

Inhabitant Rank

After your promotion to Inhabitant, you will earn the achievement Rathleton Inhabitant and you will gain voting rights on another topic, namely which boss will be available to kill. Do you want to kill the furious moohtant Bullwark, the poisonous Lisa or the mighty Glooth Fairy? You decide. The boss with the most votes will spawn. Every 14 days, the votes will be reset and the option which was the most popular at that time will take over. 

You can now also sell weapons and armor looted from local creatures to Flint.

After casting another 150 successful votes (300 in total), you will be able to ask for your third promotion.

Citizen Rank

After your promotion to Citizen, you will earn the achievement Rathleton Citizen. As of yet, no new topics to vote on have been uncovered. However, you will still be able to do tasks in the Oramond Quest and cast votes.

Rewards for becoming a citizen:

  • When you use the Slime Slide at the boat you will end up in Rathleton without having to go past the Minotaurs. Also you may use the slide back to the boat from Rathleton.
  • Ability to travel to Edron, Venore, Port Hope, Krailos, Issavi or Travora from Oramond
  • Access to Underground Glooth Factory.

After casting another 200 successful votes (500 in total), you will be able to ask for your final promotion.

Squire Rank

After your promotion to Squire, you will earn the achievement Rathleton Squire. Now you will be able to start a new quest for the magistrate, namely the Hero of Rathleton Quest.

Recommendation

In order to get the full Glooth Engineer Outfits later it is recommended to vote at least once for each shortcut, dungeon and boss Marvin is telling you. You don't need to vote for the raids. For the base outfit you need to complete Dark Trails Quest. Note: Voting topics depend on your rank, as described above.

In total, 9 voting rights are needed for the Glooth Engineer Outfit addons, i.e to vote at least once for each shortcut, dungeon and boss.

Shortcut Votings

Simply say to Marvin

hi - voting - topic - shortcut - minotaur (or) fungi (or) catacomb - 1 - yes

Dungeon Votings

Simply say to Marvin

hi - voting - topic - dungeon - golem (or) minotaur (or) wrath - 1 - yes

Boss Votings

Simply say to Marvin

hi - voting - topic - boss - Bullwark (or) Lisa (or) Glooth Fairy - 1 - yes

Raid Votings

Simply say to Marvin

hi - voting - topic - raid - minotaurs (or) mechanical creature (or) wild life - 1 - yes

Transcripts

No Rank becoming Commoner Rank

Put in 50 votes

Player: Hello
Marvin: Greetings! I guess you are here for the voting.
Player: topic
Marvin: Today you might vote for a shortcut. If you are interested some background information, feel free to ask me.
Player: shortcut
Marvin: So far you earned 50 votes. Each single vote can be spent on a different topic, but you can also cast all your votes on one voting. ...
Marvin: Well, in the topic shortcut you have the possibility to vote for shortcuts back from the minotaurs, fungi or catacombs.
Player: catacombs
Marvin: How many of your 50 votes do you want to cast?
Player: 50
Marvin: Did I get that right: You want to cast 50 of your votes on the shortcut to the catacombs?
Player: yes
Marvin: Thanks, you successfully cast your vote. Feel free to continue gathering votes by helping the city! Farewell.

Marvin: Welcome back, Player! You gathered enough points to advance in your citizen rank. Ask me anytime for promotion. Tell me if you want to participate in a voting.

Player: promotion
Marvin: You cast 50 votes. I will promote your citizen rank to commoner. Congratulations, Player! From now on, you can cast your votes on new topics.
